Possums intake restricted synthetic PocketBase native dashboard

Origin: checksum-qualified PocketBase v0.40.5 ui tree and its exact npm lock.
The license inventory and asset manifest accompany this distribution.

Bundled runtime packages: PocketBase JavaScript SDK 0.28.1 (MIT), Leaflet
1.9.4 (BSD-2-Clause), and Vite's generated modulepreload helper (MIT;
full Vite package license/third-party notices supplied). npm build tools
not emitted into browser assets are not distributed as runtime packages.
A build-time chunk-module inventory rejects newly bundled npm dependencies.

Copied public libraries: TinyMCE 6.8.6 (MIT), DOMPurify 3.2.4 (Apache-2.0
or MPL-2.0; both upstream license texts retained, Apache option used),
PrismJS 1.30.0 (MIT), uPlot 1.6.32 (MIT), Shablon (0BSD), Remix Icon
4.6.0 (Apache-2.0), IBM Plex Sans/Mono (SIL Open Font License 1.1).
Shablon's vendored file has no version header; its exact bytes are pinned by
PocketBase's source-tree hash. IBM Google-font filenames identify Sans v23
and Mono v20 distributions, not an independently verified IBM source revision.
Their family licenses are preserved. Public license snapshots without a
release tag are checksum-pinned in licenses/sources.json, not floating build
inputs. Original copyright notices and full required license texts accompany
all components, including unchanged TinyMCE plugins/themes/skins/models/icons.

TinyMCE's upstream header explicitly identifies modified DOMPurify code.
Possums changes source-input console fallbacks in TinyMCE, Prism, uPlot,
Shablon, Leaflet and the PocketBase SDK to suppress raw browser logging.
The PocketBase UI source is patched to remove installer/recovery paths,
credential URL prefills, persistent browser auth/preferences/drafts and raw
error fallbacks, to add the synthetic stored-total warning, and to omit
unchanged account values from native update payloads. This is not an upstream
PocketBase release. No font names or font files were modified.

The PocketBase-authored UI/logo and copied provider SVG marks originate in
its pinned MIT-distributed source tree. Brand names/marks remain third-party
trademarks; these notices grant no endorsement or trademark rights. None is
fetched from a CDN at runtime. See the separate application documentation for
privacy and native browser/password-manager/DevTools/history boundaries.
